entities.summary: Vera Sergeyevna Kashcheyeva was a Russian soldier. She served as a combat medic in the 120th Rifle Regiment, 39th Guards Rifle Division who was awarded the title Hero of the Soviet Union in 1944 for her actions in the Dnieper crossing.
